name: Face Pull
common_faults: pulling to neck instead of face/forehead
no external rotation at end range (turning it into a row)

substitutions.note: dumbbell isolation; no external rotation emphasis
horizontal pull; less rear-delt and external rotation focus

resistance_profile: constant cable tension; hardest at full external rotation with elbows level with ears

provenance.notes: Commonly prescribed for shoulder health: trains posterior deltoid and external rotators which are underworked in horizontal pressing. SFR heuristic.
